title: How I Monetized 5 New Faceless AI Channel in 10 Days
one_sentence_summary: A step-by-step framework for setting up, warming up, testing niches, and scaling automated faceless YouTube channels using AI tools and growth heuristics.
key_takeaways: Warm up brand new YouTube accounts for at least one week by browsing organically, watching 1-2 hours of content daily, and interacting naturally to bypass shadowbans and establish platform trust.

Evaluate potential niches using strict criteria: under 5 smaller channels with high view-to-subscriber ratios, zero channels with over 100k+ subscribers, no failing smaller channels, and a niche age under 6 months.
Use a dedicated 'dummy account' trained by watching niche-specific videos to manipulate the YouTube homepage algorithm into showing endless competitor research ideas.
Apply the Topic Transfer Method: take winning video topics from unrelated high-performing niches and adapt them to your own niche for high demand and low supply.
Make your video duration roughly 1.5x longer than competitor videos to maximize watch time and capture algorithm favorability.
Structure production via the 80/20 rule: spend 80% of your time on proven formats and 20% experimenting with new ideas.

actionable_frameworks.name: Niche Testing Framework
actionable_frameworks.description: A methodical process covering channel warmup, niche selection criteria, competitor outlier identification, and production testing of 5-10 videos before scaling or pivoting.

actionable_frameworks.name: Topic Transfer Method
actionable_frameworks.description: The practice of identifying high-performing, viral video concepts from different, non-competing niches and successfully migrating them into your target niche.

memorable_quotes: Supply and demand is not just important in your niche, but also in the video topics you choose.
